value.name: Rosa frames mother's love as healing
value.description: Rosa argues that confronting their mother's intentions is difficult but can lead to healing and understanding.
evidence: Rosa: "...it’s also a path to healing; we must trust that our mother’s love will guide us through the pain and into understanding."

value.name: Lucia expresses fear of uncovering truth
value.description: Lucia admits she is uncertain and frightened by the prospect of learning her mother's intentions.
evidence: Lucia: "I wish I could share your certainty, Rosa; the thought of unraveling her intentions feels like standing on the edge of a cliff, unsure of what lies below."

value.name: Rosa urges Lucia to face truth together
value.description: Rosa encourages Lucia to take the emotional leap with her and confront their mother's intentions side by side.
evidence: Rosa: "Then let us take that leap together, Lucia; hand in hand, we will navigate the depths of her intentions and emerge stronger on the other side."

value.name: Lucia commits to facing truth as family
value.description: Lucia agrees to proceed, but only if whatever they discover is confronted together as a family.
evidence: Lucia: "I'm willing to take that leap, but I need to promise myself that whatever we find, we face it together, as a family."

value.name: Rosa promises family unity through truth
value.description: Rosa reassures Lucia that their mother's love binds them and that uncovering the truth will unite them.
evidence: Rosa: "Absolutely, Lucia; we are bound by our mother’s love, and together we will weave the threads of her truth into a tapestry that honors her spirit and unites us all."

value.name: Lucia senses mother's presence in box
value.description: Lucia feels her mother's presence in the box and believes the hidden letter is meant to reveal secrets, though she fears the truth could divide the family.
evidence: Lucia: "I can feel Mom's presence in this box, and I know she wanted us to uncover her secrets, but what if those secrets tear us apart instead of bringing us closer?"

value.name: Lucia trembles before hidden letter
value.description: Lucia stands before the box with racing heart and trembling fingers, poised to confront the hidden letter.
evidence: （As Lucia stands before the box, her heart races, fingers trembling over the hidden letter.）

value.name: Rosa reframes mother's love as bridge
value.description: Rosa tells Lucia their mother's love was meant to connect them and help them understand one another.
evidence: Rosa: "Lucia, remember that our mother's love was never meant to divide us; it was a bridge to understanding, and together we can cross it."

value.name: Lucia resolves to honor mother's memory together
value.description: Lucia accepts that the process will be hard but agrees that facing it together may honor their mother's memory as intended.
evidence: Lucia: "I know this won't be easy, but if we face it together, maybe we can honor her memory the way she would have wanted."
